أبوالقاسم محمد بن العباس بن موسى بن جعفر العلوي

notes: «وبهذا الإسناد» opens the report: prev1 (327) also opens with it and writes no chain, so the names are taken from prev2 (326), the nearest report that writes its chain
the inherited names are placed first, in prev2's order; «جده محمد بن علي» is one link (rule 7); the bare «أبي», «أبيه» are relations
the saying is the Prophet's: the last link is علي بن أبي طالب, inherited, and no back_reference is written for «وبهذا الإسناد»
